desc: Looking to touch up an old gun or give it new life with a complete re-blackening? The Gun Black kit by Shooter's Choice is a cold black two part process that bonds to and colors the metal. It includes everything you need - including applicators - to get your gun black job done. Includes enough chemicals for up to 3 complete re-blackening's or dozens of touch ups. Like factory black, it produces a beautiful, durable finish. This easy to apply product includes Gun Black (2 oz.), Gun Cleaner Gel (1 oz.), Curing Agent (0.5 oz.), Lubricant (0.5 oz.) plus applicators, microfiber cloth, steel wool and scour pads. Be sure to follow comprehensive instructions to achieve desired results. DO NOT USE acetone, solvents, cleaners, degreasers, rust removers or any chemicals other than Shooter's Choice Gun Cleaner Gel to prepare the metal prior to refinishing. These products can leave residues in the pores of the metal and interfere with the bonding process of Shooter's Choice Gun Black.
